description: Source code for oseama utility, handling Seama seal (container) files: reading, creating, and extracting entities with options for metadata and padding.

methods.name: oseama_info_parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for info command, setting entity index.

methods.name: oseama_info_entities
methods.description: Reads and displays information about entities within a Seama file.

methods.name: oseama_info
methods.description: Handles 'info' command, displaying metadata and entity info from a Seama file.

methods.name: oseama_entity_append_file
methods.description: Appends file content to a Seama entity.

methods.name: oseama_entity_append_zeros
methods.description: Appends zeros to a Seama entity for padding.

methods.name: oseama_entity_align
methods.description: Aligns Seama entity data to specified byte boundary.

methods.name: oseama_entity_write_hdr
methods.description: Writes the entity header with MD5 checksum.

methods.name: oseama_entity
methods.description: Creates or modifies a Seama entity with options for metadata and content.

methods.name: oseama_extract_parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for extract command.

methods.name: oseama_extract_entity
methods.description: Extracts a specific entity from a Seama file to output.

methods.name: oseama_extract
methods.description: Handles 'extract' command, extracting an entity from a Seama file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the tool.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, dispatches commands based on arguments.
